mode: controlled mechanism tests on formal Host and native Pi tools; Faux Provider, isolated encrypted mkdtemp database; not autonomous model behavior

cases.name: Exact content review
cases.expected: Wrong digest rejected and unreviewed candidate never activated
cases.actual: 409; initial publish failed; current absent; matching digest review persisted

cases.name: Asynchronous publication
cases.expected: 202 is pending; only successful final operation and authoritative current imply activation
cases.actual: 202 checking/waiting; Operation applied; current exact version; revision incremented

cases.name: Changed candidate and stale write
cases.expected: Editing creates immutable candidate without inherited review; stale write rejected
cases.actual: 201; distinct new version; no new review; old review retained only on old version; stale edit409; old current retained

cases.name: Rollback and enablement
cases.expected: Reviewed candidate applies; legal rollback and enabled switches each use real Operations
cases.actual: New version applied; old version restored applied; disable and enable applied with authoritative enabled false/true

cases.name: Descriptive Knowledge
cases.expected: Knowledge revision does not alter executable current/latest; executable path cannot use Knowledge route
cases.actual: 200; skill revision +1; current/latest unchanged; executable-path Knowledge write409

cases.name: Tool Session membership
cases.expected: Actual project and Session arrays distinguish loaded, model-declared and callable
cases.actual: Same-project Sessions loaded; first callable after search; second not active; other-project Session excluded and no Skill Tool in beta

cases.name: Suggestion pagination and authorship
cases.expected: Real 35-record pagination has no overlap; user request cannot claim Agent/source/project; stale status rejected
cases.actual: 30+5 records; total35; user actor and null project; forged extra fields400; manage200 then stale409

cases.name: Adoption and discussion
cases.expected: Adoption opens independent real discussion but creates no development grant
cases.actual: Adopt200; new purpose discussion Session; Activity discussion without grant; unauthorized native write fails and file absent

cases.name: Exact Activity authorization
cases.expected: Stale revision, foreign target and unauthorized submitted target rejected; no-code completion is not publication
cases.actual: Foreign Skill403; stale409; full grant202 running; out-of-target write absent; invalid result rejected; empty packages completed with releases[] and no Skill

cases.name: Partial publication
cases.expected: An Activity failure preserves prior applied release and rejects failed candidate publication claims
cases.actual: First Skill current exact version; applied Operation has matching evolution activity; second Operation failed and no current; Activity failed; exact first admission succeeds, second denied403

cases.name: Cancel and restart
cases.expected: Cancelled activity cannot write; restart interrupts unfinished work without replay and retains applied partial results
cases.actual: Cancelled state retained; post-cancel write absent; running becomes interrupted; no unfinished Skill; previous current and partially published Skill preserved

cases.name: Authentication and Origin
cases.expected: Bearer and Origin independently enforced by actual transport
